about.title: About us

facts.title: Since 2004
facts.text: Trading food commodities across the region

facts.title: Direct sourcing
facts.text: Rice, wheat flour, pulses and other food products

intro: We are the trusted food commodities Trading Company based in Bangkok, Thailand with our associates partners HUGTS Company Ltd. Bangkok, Thailand since 2004, committed to delivering high quality products to the market across the region.

Our expertise spans the procurement and distribution of rice, wheat flour, pulses and other food products, source directly from reliable exporters by maintaining strict quality control standards and efficient supply chain practices. We ensure consistency, freshness and competitive pricing in every shipment.

goal.title: Our goal
goal.text: To consistently deliver high-quality food commodities through efficient sourcing, strict quality control and dependable supply chain management, while building long-term partnerships and contributing to sustainable food security.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To source and supply high-quality food commodities through trusted partnerships, efficient operations and ethical practices, ensuring reliability, value and long-term satisfaction for our customers.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: To establish ourselves as a leading and trusted food commodities trading company, recognized for uncompromising quality, operational excellence and integrity across regional and global markets.
